stem: Large packets of sugar are packed in cartons, each containing 12 packets. The weights of these packets are normally distributed with mean 505 g and standard deviation 3.2 g. The weights of the cartons, when empty, are independently normally distributed with mean 150 g and standard deviation 7 g.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Find the probability that the total weight of a full carton is less than 6200 g.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.stem: Small packets of sugar are packed in boxes. The total weight of a full box has a normal distribution with mean 3130 g and standard deviation 12.1 g.
parts.text: Find the probability that the weight of a randomly chosen full carton is less than double the weight of a randomly chosen full box.
